review_text_raw: Very nice restaurant with a view. It is located by Toba Lake. We came here by boa after short visitvto Samosir Island. You can reach this place by car but with a boat is another experience. We came here as part of the tour. The scenery was beautiful. You eat with the view of the lake. The food was ready when we arrived. Overall, the food is standard. They use local fish from the lake, I believe. The service was very good. It was a good experience. There are local kids waiting forcyou to throw coin to the lake so yhey can dive to find it. There are also many fishes waiting for you to throw leftover food to the lake. You can also ee egrets. Will come again next time.
